name: Prism Tetra
text:
Fearful: This unit cannot block.

Group Tactics 1: After you declare three or more attackers, you may add 1 to this unit's attack value for the remainder of the turn.

* Scatter: Discard this unit at the end of the round unless it has 1 or more status tokens on it.

name: Radiant Leviathan
text:
Coalesced: Other units you control cannot be targeted by attacks an opponent controls.

* Refract: When this unit is destroyed, place 1 [[Prism Tetra]] conjuration onto your battlefield for each status token on this unit.

name: Seafoam Snapper
text:
Hungry 1: When this unit comes into play, destroy an exhausted conjuration you control. If you do, place 1 status token on this unit.

Tough 1: After this unit is dealt damage, if there are any status tokens on it, remove them all to prevent 1 damage from being received.

name: Summon Prism Tetra
text:
[[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 2 [[sympathy:class]]: Place three [[Prism Tetra]] conjurations onto your battlefield.

**Focus 1:** Until the start of your next turn or the next round, Prism Tetras you control cannot be targeted by spells, abilities, or dice powers an opponent controls.

name: Summon Radiant Leviathan
text: Place a [[Radiant Leviathan]] conjuration onto your battlefield. Place 1 status token on it for each other conjuration you control.

name: Summon Seafoam Snapper
text: [[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[time:power]]: Place a [[Seafoam Snapper]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

name: Summon Tidal Crab
text: [[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[sympathy:class]] - 1 [[time:class]]: Place a [[Tidal Crab]] conjuration onto your battlefield. Place 2 status tokens on it.

name: Tidal Crab
text:
Unburden: [[side]]: Move 1 status token from this unit onto another unit you control.

* Slow: Reduce this unit's attack value by 1 for each status token on it.
